name: Klaus-Dieter Ziegler
bio:
Klaus-Dieter's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for model cars and a knack for tinkering. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, he started his career at a small automotive supplier, but his heart always yearned for the track. He eventually landed a role as a junior engineer for a Formula 3 team, quickly proving his worth with his meticulous approach to data analysis and simulation.

Over the years, Klaus-Dieter honed his skills, becoming a respected figure in the sim racing world. He joined Speed Kart Racing five years ago, where he is known for his ability to translate real-world conditions into accurate and challenging simulator scenarios. His focus is always on providing the drivers with the most realistic and effective training environment possible, pushing the boundaries of what can be achieved in the virtual realm. Klaus-Dieter's dedication and innovative thinking are highly valued within the team.

physical.description: Klaus-Dieter is a stocky man with a perpetual look of concentration.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn-out notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of humming quietly while calibrating the simulator.
Insists on using a specific brand of German coffee beans in the team's coffee machine.
